verdict.summary_en: Chinese/English delivery note SN-260805-698 dated 2026/08/05 from Guangzhou PackRight Packaging to Soony DC Hamburg against PO 4500318687. It lists one line, PR-RB-2207 Collector's Box Grand Heist 6, 18,500 PCS in 37 packages, 814 kg gross, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. A blue stamp reads RECEIVED 10.09.2026 DC-HAM. There are no handwritten corrections. The remarks field is empty.
red_flags: No ordered quantity is on the note, so the delivered 18,500 PCS can't be checked against the PO from this document.
The receiving signature line (收货签字) is blank. Only the RECEIVED stamp is present.
The item description is cut off at '(rig'.
observations: Red round supplier seal (Guangzhou PackRight Packaging Co. Ltd, 出货专用章, star in the centre) overlaps the table header and the unit (PCS) and packages (37) cells. Those values are still readable.
Blue rectangular stamp 'RECEIVED 10.09.2026 / DC-HAM' is slightly tilted. The date is in DD.MM.YYYY form.
The 备注 (remarks) field is empty and the receiving signature line has no signature.
PR-RB-2207 sits in the 物料号 (material no.) column, which is not a CMP- number. I recorded it as the supplier part number.
Header has a barcode. No handwriting is visible anywhere.
